xrootd_port.description: The default port for the xrootd data server.

xrootd_admin_path.description: The path where the pid and various IPC files, including the admin pipe, should be placed.

xrootd_manager_host.description: The hostname or IP address of the redirector (manager) that the cmsd on this data server node connects to.

xrootd_manager_port.description: The port number on which the redirector (manager) is listening for connections from data servers.

xrootd_export_path.description: The filesystem path that xrootd exports to clients.

xrootd_copycmd_copy.description: The command used by frm_xfrd to copy files into the exported path with the 'stage' attribute.

xrootd_pid_path.description: The directory where PID files are stored.
